author: Brent Thompson
namespace_status: Project namespace proposal; no external registration is claimed.

steps.label: Check environment and sources
inputs: configured collection; credentials in local environment
steps.description: Verify collection names, model and embeddings, accessible PDFs and ontology services. This command makes provider/network checks; it is not a no-network validator.
steps.completion: Read every printed check and require the final ready message with no [FAIL] lines. src.run.check catches check failures and does not guarantee a nonzero exit code; exit status alone is insufficient.
steps.recovery: Resolve each failed source/model/provider/store check, then rerun check and inspect its printed outcome. Exit code alone is insufficient; this command does not create a per-run completion record.
steps.effects: Calls real chat, embedding and portal services and downloads/ranks collection PDFs into shared cache. Full preflight includes ontology-store readiness; build the store first if missing.

steps.label: Prepare ontology store
steps.description: Build once before placement. This writes the shared store, downloads sources and may embed terms; do not rebuild or upgrade it during active runs.
steps.completion: Confirm the configured ontology-store DB and manifest exist and inspect ontologies status; build/require implementations define readiness. Do not rebuild an already-valid active store.
steps.recovery: Inspect the configured store status, DB and manifest first. Repair/build only if readiness is missing and no active job uses shared assets; do not rebuild an already-valid store. A build is not a per-domain stage restart.
steps.effects: Downloads ontology sources, writes the configured shared ontology store and may call embedding providers. Establish exclusive safe write scope before building.

steps.label: Select literature across collections
steps.description: Select personal/group libraries permitted by the key; expand descendants, deduplicate DOI/membership, rank citations across the entire domain, and skip unavailable PDFs. Missing citation counts rank last.
steps.completion: Confirm expected artifacts are parseable and inspect the saved stage/error records. Review content; file presence alone is not completion.
steps.recovery: CLI single-stage commands reattempt that stage in the same run; all --run-id skips recorded completion. Dashboard stage skips completed stages; restart creates a new attempt and preserves upstream/history. Inspect failures and do not mix these semantics.
steps.effects: Writes output artifacts; may call models/providers and shared read caches. Do not execute a command template without resolving scope and credentials.

bindings.COLLECTION: Existing configured collection name in src/config.py; CLI path supports its configured single collection, not arbitrary cross-library domains.
bindings.RUN_ID: User-selected unique new run ID or deliberately selected existing run to continue.
bindings.PROJECT_ID: Existing dashboard project UUID from outputs/dashboard/projects/<id>/project.json; create via Home or model.create_project.
bindings.DOMAIN_ID: Existing domain.id within that project; create via Zotero UI/model.add_domain with real accessible selections.
bindings.DOMAIN_A_RUN_ID: Explicit successful first-domain run, not an integration ID.
bindings.DOMAIN_B_RUN_ID: Explicit successful second, distinct-domain run from the intended run set.
bindings.INTEGRATION_RUN_ID: New integration ID to avoid overwriting earlier integration products.

conditions.authorized_inputs_and_write_scope: Use human-authorized input sources, runtime and output scope. An ontology template is not a grant of permission.
conditions.provider_settings_for_selected_mode: CLI reads root environment/.env; wrapper reads dashboard private settings. Check required provider/model availability without exposing values.
conditions.mode_specific_project_or_collection_conf: CLI COLLECTION must exist in src.config.COLLECTIONS. Wrapper PROJECT_ID and DOMAIN_ID must exist with real accessible collection selections. Do not substitute one mode for another.
conditions.prepared_ontology_store: Read the current src.tools.ontostore availability/require contract. A full CLI preflight requires the store. Wrapper uses the prebuilt shared store; do not rebuild it during active runs.
conditions.two_distinct_completed_domains: Select at least two distinct-domain run IDs with recorded interop, formal ontology and enriched classes; inspect failed papers and validation independently.
conditions.explicit_completed_run_selection: Select the exact intended completed run IDs; reports do not require integration.
conditions.no_active_shared_store_mutation: Establish that no running job uses shared assets before store writes; do not infer process ownership from logs.
